subject: Request: timebox extension + sandbox credit while SDK release freeze is resolved
messages:
From: Sara Levin <sara@edgeoptics.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@edgeoptics.ai>
Date: Sun, Apr 18 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: SDK release freeze blocking POC — request for short extension and credits

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from EdgeOptics — we hit a blocker this morning. Our mobile team is in a mandated release freeze (security patch rolling across our fleet) and the SDK change that your integration requires is queued behind it. That means our engineer who was going to validate the auth flow and key rotation won't be available for at least 10 business days.

The POC was due to wrap next week. Can Redwood provide a short timebox extension (14 days) and a small sandbox credit top-up so we can preserve the test data and keep the demo environment warm for our next available sprint? I attached a small log snippet that shows the failing handshake we see (integration-log-snippet.txt).

We want to avoid a cold restart of the POC — that would cost us momentum and push the exec review out of their current quarter. Happy to jump on a quick call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Sara Levin
Head of Integrations | EdgeOptics
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

---
Attachment: integration-log-snippet.txt (plain text, 4KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Levin <sara@edgeoptics.ai>, Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@edgeoptics.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, Apr 18 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK release freeze blocking POC — request for short extension and credits

Sara — thanks for the context and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the release freeze; totally understand the pressure of a security rollout.

We can do two immediate things to keep momentum:
- Approve a 14-day trial extension (no questions asked)
- Provision a 10k-token sandbox top-up and keep your demo cluster pinned so the environment doesn't cold-start

Those are approvals I can push now but I'll need a sign-off from Sales Ops for the credit allocation. I'll also loop in engineering to see if there's a low-effort workaround (client shim or temporary token proxy) that your engineers could apply without touching the release window.

Could you send the exact SDK version and the steps your mobile team runs to reproduce the handshake error? Karthik — can you and David look at the attached log and confirm if a shim is feasible? I'll draft a mutual action plan and share (proposed-map.xlsx).

Available for a 20-minute call today at 11:30 or 15:00 PT if either slot works for you.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 646-555-0198

---
Attachment: proposed-map.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, Apr 18 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK release freeze blocking POC — technical quick triage

Looping in my initial thoughts after a quick look at the log:
- The handshake error looks like a TLS/ALPN mismatch where the client is using an older HTTP/2 implementation and the new runtime expects the v2 ALPN token.
- If EdgeOptics is on SDK v1.3.x, we can add a compatibility shim that rewrites the ALPN header to the expected token; it's ~1–2 files and a quick patch. That avoids a full SDK bump.
- Need repro steps and a small sample app from their side to validate. If they can drop a build with the reproducer, we can test in the pinned demo cluster and confirm within 48 hours.

Karthik — if you can provision the pinned demo state Marcus mentioned, I'll prepare a branch with the shim and a short integration test.

David
Sr. Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Levin <sara@edgeoptics.ai>, Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@edgeoptics.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 19 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK release freeze blocking POC — timebox extension + next steps

Sara / Tom — quick update after engineering triage: David confirmed there's a short compatibility shim we can deliver that should avoid any SDK changes on your side. Two asks so we can move: 

1) Please share the minimal reproducer (even a curl + cert combo) to validate the handshake — David expects to confirm within 48 hours.
2) I need final approval from Sales Ops for the 10k-token sandbox top-up. I've prepared the MAP and the short note for ops; if you can confirm acceptance of the 14-day extension and the proposed temporary shim we can proceed.

I'll request the credit approval now (cc'd: Sales Ops in a separate thread). If approved, we'll:
- Push the shim to the demo cluster under a feature flag
- Validate with your reproducer in <48 hrs
- Extend your trial window by 14 days starting today

Proposed call: Tue Apr 20 10:00 PT for a quick walkthrough. Confirmable if that works.

Thanks — Marcus
From: Sara Levin <sara@edgeoptics.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lewis <tom.lewis@edgeoptics.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 19 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK release freeze blocking POC — timebox extension + next steps

Marcus — that plan sounds great. Tom will drop the reproducer by end of day (small sample app + steps). We accept the 14-day extension and the sandbox top-up — thanks for moving quickly on this.

We'll be on the Tue 10:00 PT call. Appreciate the help getting us out of a freeze without blocking the exec review.

Best,
Sara
